## Core Agentic AI Services


We design, deploy, and govern autonomous intelligent agents that transform complex enterprise workflows into streamlined, measurable outcomes. From discovery to integration, our agentic ecosystem scales with your ambition.











### Autonomous Task Agents


Intelligent agents that independently execute complex, multi-step tasks. They learn, adapt, and optimize workflows without human intervention, driving efficiency across your operations.










### Multi-Agent Workflow Design


Orchestrate specialized AI agents that collaborate, negotiate, and solve problems together. We architect swarms that mirror your organizational structure for seamless scalability.










### Enterprise AI Integration


Embed agentic intelligence directly into your existing infrastructure. We ensure compliance, security, and seamless data flow between your systems and our autonomous agents.








From autonomous task execution and collaborative agent swarms to deep enterprise integration, our services form a cohesive lifecycle. We align intelligent systems with your operational goals, regulatory compliance, and measurable business outcomes — ensuring every agentic solution delivers tangible value.

# Agentic AI That Thinks, Acts, and Adapts


testai engineers autonomous intelligent agents that transform complex business workflows into orchestrated, self-improving systems. From autonomous coordination to adaptive decision-making, our agentic solutions operate at the frontier of artificial intelligence, turning strategic intent into measurable outcomes.




















## Agentic AI Capabilities


Explore the core pillars that empower autonomous intelligence to transform your workflows, decision-making, and operational scale.









### Agent Strategy


Design autonomous agent architectures tailored to your enterprise goals, ensuring intelligent task decomposition and adaptive execution.








### Workflow Automation


Orchestrate end-to-end processes with intelligent agents that learn, adapt, and optimize complex business operations in real time.








### Knowledge Retrieval Orchestration


Leverage RAG-powered agents to synthesize insights from vast data lakes, delivering precise, context-aware answers instantly.








### Human-in-the-Loop Design


Integrate human oversight seamlessly into agentic workflows, ensuring safety, compliance, and nuanced decision-making at critical junctures.








### API & System Integration


Connect agentic intelligence directly to your existing stack through robust APIs, turning legacy systems into dynamic, AI-driven platforms.








### Monitoring & Governance


Maintain full visibility and control with agentic observability dashboards, audit trails, and policy enforcement across all AI operations.














## Our Agentic Delivery Process


We deploy autonomous AI agents through a proven four-step methodology that transforms complex workflows into intelligent, self-improving systems. Every phase is designed to collaborate, prototype, integrate, and refine — ensuring your business stays at the cutting edge of artificial intelligence innovation.






01

### Discover


We map your operational landscape, identifying high-impact opportunities where agentic AI can autonomously reason, plan, and execute. Through deep collaboration with your teams, we define success metrics and architect the agent's decision framework.












02

### Design


We prototype autonomous agents using modular architectures and advanced reasoning models. Each agent is crafted to handle complex, multi-step tasks with built-in guardrails and seamless human-in-the-loop escalation paths.






03

### Deploy


Agents are integrated directly into your existing infrastructure via secure APIs and enterprise connectors. We orchestrate deployment with rigorous testing, ensuring agents operate reliably at scale while maintaining full compliance and data governance.












04

### Optimize


We continuously monitor agent performance, feeding real-world outcomes back into the learning loop. Through iterative refinement and model updates, your agents become smarter, faster, and more autonomous over time.






















## Engineered for Enterprise Transformation


Our agentic AI solutions redefine operational scale by embedding autonomous intelligence directly into your core workflows. We deliver unmatched reliability, rapid execution, and strategic decision support that evolves with your business objectives.












### Infinite Scalability


Deploy agentic workflows that autonomously scale across departments, geographies, and data volumes without linear cost increases. Our architecture ensures your AI workforce grows in lockstep with demand.








### Enterprise Reliability


Built on robust, self-healing agent protocols that maintain 99.9% uptime. Redundant decision pathways and continuous validation loops ensure mission-critical operations never falter.









### Blazing Execution Speed


Reduce complex process cycles from days to minutes. Our agents execute multi-step reasoning and action chains in parallel, dramatically accelerating time-to-insight and time-to-market.








### Strategic Decision Intelligence


Move beyond dashboards. Our agents synthesize real-time data streams into actionable foresight, empowering leadership with predictive analytics and autonomous strategic recommendations.

# Architecting the Next Generation of Autonomous Systems


At testai, we are not just observing the evolution of artificial intelligence — we are actively building the infrastructure for it. Our mission is to bridge the gap between today's complex operational challenges and a future where intelligent, agentic systems handle intricate workflows with precision and autonomy. By pushing beyond simple automation, we design AI that thinks, adapts, and executes, positioning our partners at the very frontier of technological capability.


Our perspective is shaped by the conviction that the next wave of enterprise transformation will be driven by autonomous agents. These are not mere chatbots or reactive tools; they are proactive digital collaborators capable of managing multi-step logic, interacting with diverse data environments, and making informed decisions in real-time. testai exists to turn this vision into a tangible, scalable, and secure reality for organizations ready to lead.






















## Our Foundational Values


Guided by principles that ensure intelligent systems serve humanity with integrity, precision, and unwavering accountability.










### Intelligence with Accountability


Every autonomous decision our agents make is traceable, auditable, and aligned with human-defined objectives. We embed explainability into the core architecture, ensuring that as our AI solutions scale, they remain transparent and answerable to the organizations and people they empower.








### Automation with Human Oversight


We design agentic workflows that augment human capability, not replace it. Our frameworks maintain a critical human-in-the-loop position, allowing experts to guide, override, and refine autonomous processes, ensuring judgment and empathy remain at the center of every operation.








### Innovation with Operational Discipline


We push the boundaries of artificial intelligence while adhering to rigorous engineering standards. Our commitment to disciplined deployment means that every breakthrough is tested, hardened, and integrated with enterprise-grade reliability before it ever reaches a production environment.















## The Minds Behind Agentic Intelligence


Our leadership team combines deep expertise in autonomous systems, enterprise AI strategy, and organizational transformation. We are architects of the future, building intelligent agents that redefine how work gets done.











### Agent Architecture


Leading the design of autonomous agent frameworks that integrate seamlessly with existing enterprise ecosystems. Specializing in multi-agent orchestration and robust decision-making pipelines.












### AI Strategy


Translating cutting-edge artificial intelligence examples into actionable business roadmaps. Guiding organizations through the adoption of agentic AI to unlock new levels of efficiency and innovation.












### Enterprise Transformation


Re-engineering organizational structures and workflows around autonomous intelligence. Ensuring a smooth cultural and technical shift towards a future powered by intelligent digital agents.

Answers

## Frequently Asked Questions


Everything you need to know about integrating agentic AI into your workflows — from project fit to governance.






### What types of projects are best suited for agentic AI?


Agentic AI excels in multi-step, complex workflows that require autonomous decision-making — think supply chain orchestration, customer service triage, and real-time data analysis. If your process involves conditional logic and dynamic data sources, it's likely a strong fit.





### How long does implementation typically take?


Timelines vary by scope, but most enterprise deployments move from discovery to a live pilot within 8–12 weeks. We prioritize rapid prototyping so you can see autonomous agents in action early and iterate based on real performance data.





### Can your agents integrate with our existing tech stack?


Yes. Our platform is built with an API-first architecture, supporting seamless integration with major CRMs, ERPs, cloud providers, and custom internal tools. We map your existing data flows before any code is written.





### How do you handle governance, security, and compliance?


Every agent operates within a configurable governance framework that enforces role-based access, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. We align with SOC 2, GDPR, and HIPAA standards to ensure enterprise-grade trust.





### What does the typical pricing model look like?


We offer flexible pricing based on agent complexity, transaction volume, and support tier. Most clients start with a fixed-scope pilot, then transition to a usage-based model that scales with the value delivered.





### Do you provide ongoing training and optimization?


Absolutely. Autonomous agents improve with feedback. We provide continuous model fine-tuning, performance dashboards, and quarterly business reviews to ensure your AI workforce evolves alongside your business goals.

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  6/5/2026



testai ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: testai

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  June 5, 2026



testai is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: testai

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.

## 9. Changes to Terms of Use

## 10. Service Termination

## 11. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution


These terms of use are governed by applicable laws. Any disputes will be resolved in accordance with local jurisdiction, with preference given to arbitration or mediation where possible.
